articles.title: India's Revised National Biodiversity Action Plan (NBAP) Aligned with Kunming-Montreal Targets
articles.summary: India updates its NBAP to align national conservation goals with 23 global targets set under the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.
prelims: The 30x30 target aims to effectively conserve at least 30% of terrestrial, inland water, and coastal areas by 2030.
National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) is a statutory autonomous body established under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002.
Incorporates legally binding Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) mechanisms for local community resources.
articles.mains: Examine the challenges in implementing the updated National Biodiversity Action Plan while balancing economic growth and indigenous rights in India.

articles.title: RBI Rolls Out Offline Capabilities for Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC-R)
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India introduces offline and programmable capabilities for the retail Digital Rupee to facilitate transactions in network-constrained environments.
prelims: CBDC is a sovereign currency issued by a central bank in alignment with its monetary policy.
Offline functionality utilizes secure hardware-based elements to prevent double-spending without active internet connection.
Programmability enables targeted distribution of central and state government welfare subsidies.
articles.mains: Discuss how offline and programmable CBDC features can bridge India's digital financial divide and enhance welfare delivery.

articles.title: NDMA Initiates Comprehensive Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) Risk Reduction Plan
articles.summary: The National Disaster Management Authority deploys automated early warning monitoring systems across high-risk Himalayan glacial lakes.
prelims: GLOFs occur when a natural moraine or ice dam containing a glacial lake suddenly breaches.
Integrates Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and real-time telemetry sensors for high-altitude monitoring.
High-vulnerability sites include South Lhonak Lake (Sikkim) and Lake Kedartal (Uttarakhand).
articles.mains: Critically evaluate the vulnerability of the Indian Himalayan Region to GLOF disasters and suggest structural and non-structural mitigation strategies.

articles.title: India-ASEAN Digital Work Plan 2026: Enhancing Cross-Border DPI Interoperability
articles.summary: India and ASEAN adopt a joint digital initiative focusing on AI governance, cybersecurity, and scaling Digital Public Infrastructure across Southeast Asia.
prelims: ASEAN is a regional grouping of 10 Southeast Asian nations; India became a full Dialogue Partner in 1996.
Focuses on integrating India's UPI and digital identity frameworks with ASEAN national payment gateways.
Aligns with the strategic framework of India's Act East Policy and the Indo-Pacific Vision.
articles.mains: Analyze Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) as an instrument of India's soft power diplomacy in strengthening ties with ASEAN nations.

articles.title: Department of Biotechnology Operationalizes BioE3 Policy Biomanufacturing Hubs
articles.summary: Guidelines are released for setting up high-performance biomanufacturing hubs under the BioE3 policy to drive a circular bioeconomy.
prelims: BioE3 stands for Biotechnology for Economy, Environment, and Employment.
Prioritizes bio-foundries, bio-based polymers, carbon capture bioprocesses, and precision therapeutics.
Nodal agency for implementation is the Department of Biotechnology (DST, Ministry of Science & Technology).
articles.mains: Assess the potential of the BioE3 policy in advancing India's transition toward a low-carbon circular economy.
